body.statement: For every admissible \(n\), use only the schedules \[M_n=\lfloor n^{1/72}\rfloor\vee1,\quad T_n=2^{\lfloor(\log_2n)/12\rfloor},\quad\varepsilon_n=T_n^{-1},\quad G_n=\lceil n^{3/4}\rceil,\quad\delta_n=n^{-3/2}.\] Exact algebraic arithmetic in \(\mathbb Q(\alpha_n)\) computes \(B_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n}^\dagger\); the evaluator returns rational \(U_{n,G_n}^\dagger\), \(B^-_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\), and \(B^+_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\) satisfying \[B^-_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\le B_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n}^\dagger\le B^+_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n},\qquad B^+_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}-B^-_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\le\delta_n,\] and \[n^{4/3}\{n^{-1}-U_{n,G_n}^\dagger\}\le n^{4/3}\{n^{-1}-R_n(c^\dagger)\}\le n^{4/3}\{n^{-1}-B^-_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\}.\] The distance of each displayed endpoint from \(\mathfrak L^\dagger\) is at most \[\beta^\dagger(\varepsilon_n,T_n)+C_{\varepsilon_n,T_n}^\dagger(1+M_n)^6n^{-1/6}+\frac{n^{4/3}}{4G_n^2}+\Delta_{\mathrm{shell}}^\dagger(n,M_n)+n^{4/3}\{B^+_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}-B^-_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\}.\] Every term in this single-schedule budget converges to zero, including \(\Delta_{\mathrm{shell}}^\dagger(n,M_n)\to0\), \(\beta^\dagger(\varepsilon_n,T_n)\to0\), and the scaled algebraic enclosure term. For every rational \(\eta>0\), \(\mathsf E\) terminates with a computable \(N^\dagger(\eta)\) such that the displayed error sum is at most \(\eta\) for every \(n\ge N^\dagger(\eta)\); isolating intervals are refined within the width-\(\delta_n\) request until the enclosure term meets its assigned rational tolerance. This is a cross-sample modulus rather than a same-sample action-grid certificate.
body.justification: The explicit error budget turns a limiting theorem into a finite, checkable claim and separates cross-sample convergence from action-grid discretization.
body.gap: The accepted parent bounds the two certificates at a selected \(n\) by \(1/(4G^2)\) but gives no computable threshold or allocation-shell modulus linking different population sizes.
body.consumer: A protocol designer can certify worst-case precision at a planned sample size from one prespecified sequence of tube widths, truncations, allocation radii, action grids, and rational enclosure widths.
